limitation: This is a specification. Nothing is implemented, run or tested beyond the consistency checks of the registers themselves.
Every result in this package is builder-run. Nothing is independently verified.
A deny-list can show that listed terms are absent; it cannot prove that no domain concept is present.
The core evaluates licence status and window only. It cannot know what a licence permits.
The core records an owner approval reference; it cannot establish that the approval is genuine. That is the host's verifier (MIE-OQ-17).
Signals report observed movement. Observed movement is not a forecast, and nothing here claims any signal predicts a price.
The decision-table language is deliberately small. Some real decision logic may not be expressible and would need a later vocabulary or predicate change.
The synthetic pack proves structural portability only. It says nothing about any real market.
No real feed, licence, vendor or live system is involved; feed behaviour is covered only through contract analogues.
Same-code-and-shape isolation does not remove timing side channels; none are claimed to be closed.
Date granularity only; intraday movement cannot be represented (MIE-OQ-06).
The Section 08 change request is a draft. Until approved, no APG finding may use a market signal, and the APG pack is incomplete and unconnected.
No performance, capacity, durability or availability claim is made.
This revision has had no independent review. The delivered v0.1 package passed the auditor's integrity and consistency checks only and was not approved for implementation.
Licence records live inside immutable packs, so any change of a licence status or window needs a new pack version; the core cannot learn of a licence change by itself.

The mapping from M6 observation attributes and kind values to the core's attributes, class and basis has not been derived; it will be derived from M6 source at implementation start. This is blocker BLK-02: implementation cannot be authorised until the mapping is derived and independently reviewed (MIE-R-70).

The core orders an audit append before a state commit and attempts a FAILED event after a later store failure. It cannot make the two atomic; a crash between them can leave an ACCEPTED event for a change that did not happen (MIE-OQ-23). This is blocker BLK-01: implementation cannot be authorised until an explicit design decision on atomicity is recorded; the builder makes none (MIE-R-70).
retrieved_at is asserted by the feed adapter. The core has no clock and checks only that it is not earlier than as_of; a wrong adapter clock is not detectable by the core.

Signal influence is structural (rule position), so a result can be labelled DIRECT or PRECEDENCE when the signal did not in fact change the outcome. The label can over-state influence and cannot under-state it (MIE-OQ-26).

The core cannot judge whether a relative or absolute movement measure is meaningful for a series, nor whether a negative value is economically sensible; the pack owner chooses the value domain, basis and threshold, and crosses_zero only warns.

The Section 08 cascade impact assessment has not been performed; the draft change request records only the builder's keyword scan of Section 08, the RTM and the terminology register. This is blocker BLK-03 (MIE-R-70). The Section 08 change itself also stays undecided (MIE-OQ-12).
